visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a woman with dark hair and a patterned white face mask walking through a brightly lit airport terminal. The background shows blurred travelers and shop signage. (2) Close-up of a retail display shelf filled with rows of small nail polish bottles under bright studio-style lighting. (3) The woman is seen sitting in a business-class airplane seat, wrapped in a blue and white character blanket, focused on knitting a beige garment with wooden needles. (4) A digital seatback screen displays a colorful flight path map with the location label 'Bangkok' clearly visible. (5) Sequential close-up shots of airplane meals: first, a plate with bread and butter; second, a gourmet appetizer with prawns, scallops, and asparagus; third, a main course of sliced beef with mushrooms and noodles. (6) The woman takes a bite of the beef and noodles while still wrapped in her blanket. (7) A night view from an airplane window showing the expansive, glittering lights of a city below. (8) The woman walks through a different airport terminal in Bangkok, speaking to the camera while wearing her mask. (9) She holds up a garment tag for 'Jason Wu for EVA Air' and is later shown wearing gray pajamas in her seat. (10) She puts on a black eye mask to sleep; a female flight attendant in a pink uniform and a male attendant are briefly seen in the background. (11) In the airplane lavatory mirror, she shows her pajamas before a quick transition to a black dress and blue top. (12) Sitting in her seat, she applies eye makeup and later holds up a pink bottle of nail polish, showing off her painted nails. (13) An aerial view of the daytime landscape over land near Vienna, featuring flat farmlands and small settlements. (14) The woman walks and talks in the Vienna airport terminal corridor. (15) A final shot shows a large pile of silver suitcases stacked near a table in an airport cafe where several people are gathered.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins speaking with a moderate, casual cadence over the ambient hum of an airport terminal. The acoustic space has a wide reverb characteristic of a public hall. (2) A sharp transition shift occurs with the sound of movement or rustling as the scene changes to a retail shelf. (3) The audio track becomes dominated by a constant, broadband low-frequency hum of an airplane engine in the cabin. The woman's voice occasionally speaks over this background noise, showing higher pitch during moments of excitement. (4) The ambient noise profile shifts to a slightly different airport hallway reverb in Bangkok, with the female voice sounding clear and energetic. (5) Back in the cabin, the heavy engine hum returns, layered with the subtle, high-frequency rhythmic clicking of wooden knitting needles and the soft rustle of fabric. (6) The woman's voice continues, detailing her experience with a pajama brand, competing with the static airplane cabin noise floor. (7) Faint high-frequency clinks of cutlery against dishes are heard during the meal segments, mixed into the engine hum. (8) Upon arrival in Vienna, the engine noise stops, replaced by the lighter, bustling ambiance of an airport terminal with distant footsteps and announcements. (9) The final segment features a denser mix of multiple overlapping voices chatting and the mechanical sounds of rolling luggage wheels in a cafeteria-like setting.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Chronological Travel Progression -> Product Experiences -> Arrival
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A personal travel vlog documenting a long-haul flight from Taiwan to Vienna via Bangkok, highlighting the comfort of business class services, specific brand products (nail polish, blankets, and pajamas), and the travel itinerary.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent close-ups of product branding, mention of website giveaways for the blanket, and showcasing the performance of the nail polish and pajamas.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high density of subtitles to narrate a personal journey while seamlessly integrating product placements into the travel narrative.
